sections.title: Where Bhopal businesses lose leads every day
sections.content:
Most local businesses do not have a lead problem. They have a follow-up problem.

  • A WhatsApp enquiry arrives at 10:40 pm and gets a reply the next afternoon. By then the customer has booked elsewhere.
  • Missed calls during busy clinic hours are never called back.
  • Leads from Meta ads sit in a spreadsheet nobody opens.
  • Staff answer the same ten questions (fees, timings, location, parking) fifty times a week.

These are exactly the jobs AI handles well: fast, repetitive, rule-based and available at any hour.

sections.title: What we build
sections.content:
WhatsApp AI agents

An AI assistant on your WhatsApp Business number answers common questions in English, Hindi or Hinglish, shares fees, timings and directions, collects the customer’s details and passes serious enquiries to your team. It is trained only on your approved information. [[VERIFY: confirm WhatsApp Business API setup is offered]]

Lead capture and instant follow-up

Every enquiry from your website, Google Business Profile, Meta ads or a missed call gets an immediate response and lands in one place, such as a CRM or a shared sheet. Leads that do not reply get polite, scheduled follow-ups.

Appointment and booking automation

Customers pick a slot, get confirmations and reminders on WhatsApp, and can reschedule without calling. This suits clinics, salons, coaching demos and property site visits.

Review request automation

After a visit or purchase, customers receive a short, personal request for a Google review. This feeds directly into your local SEO results.

AI content workflows

We set up AI-assisted processes for drafting social posts, product descriptions, ad variations and reports, with a human edit step built in so quality and accuracy hold.

Custom AI tools and web apps

For businesses with a specific internal problem, such as quotation generation, document summarising or internal knowledge search, we design and build small custom tools. [[VERIFY: scope of web and software builds]]

sections.title: Our principles for using AI responsibly
sections.subtitle: Clear boundaries to protect customer trust and data privacy:

promises.reality: Every agent has a clear handover to a real person, and sensitive questions (medical, legal, financial advice) are routed to staff, not answered by AI.
The AI answers from content you have signed off, which prevents made-up answers.
We collect only what is needed, store it in accounts you own, and design with India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act in mind. [[VERIFY: have legal review DPDP wording before publishing]]
AI can still misunderstand unusual questions. We monitor conversations in the first weeks and keep improving.

faqs.q: What does an AI agency do?
faqs.a: An AI agency designs and builds AI-powered tools and automations for businesses. For local businesses, that usually means WhatsApp or website chat agents, automatic lead follow-up, appointment booking, review requests and AI-assisted content creation, set up so staff spend less time on repetitive work and respond to customers faster.

faqs.q: Can AI reply to my customers on WhatsApp?
faqs.a: Yes. Using the official WhatsApp Business Platform, an AI agent can answer common questions, share details, collect information and book appointments at any hour. It should be trained only on your approved information and hand complex or sensitive conversations to a real person on your team.

No. In local businesses, AI works best at the repetitive first step: answering routine questions, capturing details and sending reminders. Your staff then handle the conversations that need judgment, empathy or negotiation. Most clients use the time saved to follow up more leads, not to cut their team.

faqs.q: Is AI automation affordable for a small business?
faqs.a: Usually, yes. Starting with one workflow, such as replying to WhatsApp enquiries or following up missed calls, keeps costs low and shows a clear return quickly. We recommend proving one automation before expanding, so you only pay for systems that save real time or win real leads.

faqs.q: Is my customer data safe with AI tools?
faqs.a: It depends on how the system is built. We use established platforms, keep data in accounts you own, collect only what the workflow needs, and keep sensitive conversations with your staff. We also design with India’s data protection law in mind and explain exactly where your data goes before anything goes live.
